svg.text: Dual-Chamber Anatomical Vacuum Interface • V-Contour System

g.text: Follows A-shape contour for optimal seal
• Clean all surfaces with 70% IPA, air dry
• Inspect for cracks, verify port dimensions
• Align central aperture with Zone 2 opening
• Mount electrodes flush with interior wall
• Press-fit Luer connectors into ports P1, P2, P3
• Install AVL sensor taps, verify seal
• Stretch seal over shell rim following A-contour
• Pressure test each zone to -60 mmHg
AVL-1 → MCP3008 Ch0 → Zone 1 pressure monitoring
AVL-2 → MCP3008 Ch1 → Zone 2 pressure monitoring
